Rogers Shines and Martinez Sent Off as Chelsea Beats Manchester United 2-0

02 Nov 2026, 04:31 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

1 min read

Key takeawaysChelsea secured a 2-0 home victory against 10-man Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, with second-half goals from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer. The result piles further pressure on Manchester United following a difficult outing.

Match Overview

Chelsea secured a 2-0 home victory against 10-man Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, with second-half goals from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer. The result piles further pressure on Manchester United following a difficult outing.

Key Match Events

  • Opening Goal: Morgan Rogers scored his sixth goal of the season in the 50th minute, utilizing his pace to break through United's defense with a skillful finish.
  • Red Card and Penalty: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez received a red card after conceding a penalty for a reckless challenge.
  • Second Goal: Cole Palmer successfully converted the resulting penalty kick to double Chelsea's lead.

  • Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United): Rated 3. Performed adequately until conceding the penalty and receiving a red card.
  • Mike Penders (Chelsea): Rated 7. Remained steady under scrutiny and made several comfortable saves.
